title: FHFA House Price Index — Monthly Index (July 2027), 9:00 a.m. ET
source: EST: fhfa.gov/data/hpi, fetched direct 2026-09-06 by this session (HTTP 200, 89,663 bytes) and parsed in full rather than inherited from a sibling. Its posted "2027 HPI Release Dates" table names twelve rows, of which the ninth reads verbatim "Tuesday, September 28 | Monthly Index | July 2027". The full table is Jan 26 / Feb 23 (Quarterly, 2026Q4) / Mar 30 / Apr 27 / May 25 (Quarterly, 2027Q1) / Jun 29 / Jul 27 / Aug 31 (Quarterly, 2027Q2) / Sep 28 / Oct 26 / Nov 30 (Quarterly, 2027Q3) / Dec 28 -- every row labelled "Tuesday" by FHFA itself, and every one a last Tuesday, so the quarterly editions fall on Feb / May / Aug / Nov and this September row is a MONTHLY index, not a quarterly one. The 9:00 a.m. ET release time is the agency's standing convention, recorded on the sibling fhfa-hpi-2027-02-23 entry from FHFA's own 2026Q2 report appendix ("Public FHFA HPI(R) releases occur at ...") and not separately re-sourced here. Filed estimate rather than confirmed because this session read only the landing-page table and did not fetch the published-report appendix that the confirmed sibling entries cite as their second FHFA primary -- the promotion path is that appendix, not a better landing-page read. Discovered during the consumer-confidence-2027-09-28 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the consumer-confidence-2027-09-28 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). Proposed because it is the ONLY other event dated anywhere in September 2027 that this session could source, and it lands on the same morning one hour ahead of the Conference Board print -- the same 9:00-then-10:00 pairing the 08-31 sibling proposed for August, and the second instance of it in 2027. It is NOT the same kind of release: 2027-08-31 is FHFA's QUARTERLY edition (June 2027 and 2027Q2) while this one is a MONTHLY index covering July 2027 data, so a lane comparing the two should not treat them as a repeat. TWO NOTES FOR WHOEVER TAKES IT. (1) The consumer-confidence chain has now checked FHFA's posted 2027 table against its own rule-derived last Tuesdays TWICE, on two separate fetches a session apart, and got 12 of 12 both times -- that is a stable snapshot, not a commitment, and the standing kill switch is a re-read showing any 2027 row changed. (2) The 9:00 ET slot means any tape work on 2027-09-28 at intraday resolution has to separate this release's aftermath from the 10:00 print; the CB chain's whole study is at daily-bar resolution and explicitly says nothing about that window. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
